text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. These tasks include learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a key part of AI. It allows computers to learn from data and improve without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses artificial neural networks to process complex information. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask voice assistants questions, get movie recommendations, or use navigation apps. AI also helps doctors diagnose diseases and makes self-driving cars possible.
